catalog.title: Demo Paths
catalog.author: simetro team
catalog.description: A compact triangular loop that demonstrates the v1 node, path, mover, goal, and agent primitives.
catalog.palette_note: Dark background with a light foreground and three saturated route accents.
catalog.layout_note: Three nodes form a wide triangular silhouette so the loop reads at a glance.
catalog.node_language_note: Circle, square, and triangle nodes each use the accent color of their outgoing or incoming route.
catalog.mover_path_note: Each mover starts on a different colored edge of the primary loop.
catalog.review_note: JSON reviewed for v1 validity, palette separation, triangular silhouette, three intentional node shapes/colors, and visible mover start paths.
